Cuocerli a fuoco basso circa 3 ore, finc: Cook them over a low heat for about 3 hours, until they crush between your fingers; salt them halfway through cooking.
Passarli al setaccio o al passaverdure,: Pass them through a sieve or food mill, pressing with a wooden spoon.
Diluire il passato con l'acqua di cottur: Thin the purée with the cooking water to a soft cream, add salt and pepper and heat for 5 minutes.
Tostare le fette di pane sulla griglia 2: Toast the slices of bread on the grill for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crisp, and put them in the plates.
Versare la minestra sul pane e servire;: Pour the soup over the bread and serve; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 2.35: dried broad beans, chickpeas or peas, soaked overnight and cooked for hours, passed through the sieve, thinned with water or broth, with salt, pepper and, if you like, slices of bread; 120 grams of pulses per person. Green peas cook for an hour and a half, yellow ones for two and a half hours. It is a dish of the whole province of Trento: here it is listed under the provincial capital.
La sera prima mettere in ammollo separat: The evening before, soak the white beans, chickpeas and dried peas separately in cold water.
Cuocere ogni legume a parte partendo da: Cook each pulse separately starting from cold water; after it first comes to the boil change the water and salt it: chickpeas 3 hours, beans 2 hours, peas 1 hour 30 minutes, lentils 40 minutes.
In una casseruola scaldare l'olio e soff: In a casserole heat the oil and fry the chopped onion and leek with the pounded savory over a medium heat for 8 minutes, until golden.
Unire tutti i legumi scolati al soffritt: Add all the drained pulses to the soffritto and let them take on the flavours for 5 minutes.
Cuocere i maccheroncini in 2 litri di br: Cook the maccheroncini in 2 litres of boiling broth for 10 minutes.
Aggiungere i legumi, il sale che occorre: Add the pulses, the salt needed, the pepper and the cinnamon and heat for 3 minutes.
Scaldare la passata di pomodoro in un pe: Heat the tomato passata in a small pan.
Servire il minestrone fumante con il gra: Serve the minestrone steaming hot with the grana and a spoonful of passata; it keeps in the fridge for 2 days.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 3.15: a glass each of small white beans, lentils, chickpeas and dried green peas cooked separately, dressed with a soffritto of oil, onion, leek and savory («peverella»), added to 150 grams of maccheroncini cooked in broth with pepper and a small pinch of cinnamon, served with cheese and tomato sauce; for 3-4 people. It is a dish of the whole province of Trento: here it is listed under the provincial capital.
Brodo: mettere il muscolo di manzo, la c: Broth: put the beef shin, carrot, onion and celery in the cold water with a pinch of salt and simmer gently, half covered, for 2 hours 30 minutes, skimming; strain it (about 3 litres remain).
Cuocere a parte in acqua i fagioli fresc: Separately, cook the fresh beans in water for about 1 hour 30 minutes and the peas for 30 minutes.
Pestare con la mezzaluna il lardo, le ci: Pound the lard, onions, basil and parsley with the mezzaluna and fry the battuto in a large pot over a medium heat for 8 minutes.
Unire la carota, il sedano rapa e il por: Add the finely chopped carrot, celeriac and leek, the Savoy cabbage, white cabbage and lettuce in strips, the herbs, the diced potatoes, and the drained beans and peas.
Far rosolare tutto 10 minuti mescolando,: Brown everything for 10 minutes, stirring, then pour in two ladles of water from the broth and all the broth.
Boil over a medium-low heat for 1 hour.
Aggiungere il riso e cuocerlo 15-18 minu: Add the rice and cook it for 15-18 minutes, with salt and pepper.
Unire il grana e servire; d'estate è buo: Add the grana and serve; in summer it is good cold too, and it keeps in the fridge for 2 days.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 3.16: a battuto of lard, onions, basil and parsley, then carrot, celery, leek, Savoy cabbage, white cabbage, lettuce, herbs (thyme, marjoram, savory, chervil, chives), potatoes, beans and peas, an hour in the broth and at the end eight handfuls of rice; «in estate questo minestrone si può collocare in cantina e gustare freddo» (in summer this minestrone can be put in the cellar and enjoyed cold). For six people. It is a dish of the whole province of Trento: here it is listed under the provincial capital.
In una pentola portare a bollore il latt: In a pot bring the milk to the boil with 20 g of butter.
Versare la farina di mais a pioggia, con: Pour in the maize flour in a stream, with a pinch of salt and 30 g of sugar, stirring with the whisk.
Cuocere a fuoco basso 40 minuti, mescola: Cook over a low heat for 40 minutes, stirring often, like a soft polenta.
Con un cucchiaio bagnato staccare gnocch: With a wet spoon scoop small dumplings from the polenta and arrange them on a plate.
Mescolare lo zucchero rimasto con la can: Mix the remaining sugar with the cinnamon and dust it over the monchi (dumplings).
Sciogliere il resto del burro e versarlo: Melt the rest of the butter and pour it over.
Bagnare con un goccio di latte la pentol: Moisten the pot with a drop of milk to loosen the crusty bits and scatter them over the monchi, dressed the same way.
Serve hot; they are eaten the same day.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 10.5: yellow maize flour measured with a glass, cooked like a polenta in a little over twice its volume of milk with butter, salt and sugar, taken out in little dumplings, dusted with sugar and cinnamon and dressed with melted butter; the crusty bits from the pot are dressed the same way too. It is a dish of the whole province of Trento: here it is listed under the provincial capital.
Sulla spianatoia mescolare la farina con: On the pastry board mix the flour with the icing sugar, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg and baker's ammonia.
Unire gli albumi e l'acqua e impastare f: Add the egg whites and water and knead into a firm, smooth dough.
Stenderla sulla spianatoia infarinata al: Roll it out on the floured board a little under half a centimetre thick.
Tagliare tondi di 6 cm con un bicchiere,: Cut 6 cm rounds with a glass, knead the trimmings together and repeat.
Disporli distanziati su una teglia unta: Arrange them well apart on a baking tray greased with the butter and floured.
Spennellarli con un po' d'acqua e cospar: Brush them with a little water and sprinkle them with pearl sugar.
Cuocerli in forno statico a 160 °C per 1: Bake them in a conventional oven at 160 °C for 15-18 minutes: they must stay grey, without taking on colour, and are taken out before they harden.
Lasciarli raffreddare e conservarli in u: Leave them to cool and keep them in a tin for up to 1 month.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 10.83: 300 grams of flour, 300 of sugar, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg and ammonium carbonate, kneaded with two egg whites and water, cut into small rounds with a glass, moistened and sprinkled with sugar grains, baked in a moderate oven: «devono restar grigi» (they must stay grey). It is a dish of the whole province of Trento: here it is listed under the provincial capital.
Pulire bene le orecchie di maiale: passa: Clean the pig's ears well: pass them over the flame to singe off the hairs, scrape them with a knife and wash them.
Metterle in una pentola con carota, cipo: Put them in a pot with carrot, onion, celery, salt and cold water to cover.
Portare a bollore e cuocere a fuoco bass: Bring to the boil and cook over a low heat for 2 hours, until tender to a fork.
Scolarle, asciugarle e tagliarle a metà: Drain them, dry them and cut them in half lengthways.
Sciogliere il burro e spennellarle da tu: Melt the butter and brush them with it on all sides.
Passarle nel pangrattato, premendo perch: Coat them in the breadcrumbs, pressing so that they stick.
Scaldare lo strutto in una padella a 170: Heat the lard in a frying pan to 170 °C and fry them for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden.
Scolarle su carta, salarle e servirle ca: Drain them on paper, salt them and serve them hot with mustard; boiled, they keep in the fridge for 2 days.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 7.77: pig's ears are boiled with the vegetables, brushed with butter, breaded, fried in lard and enjoyed with mustard or horseradish sauce. Quantities estimated for the ingredients the source gives as «q.b.» (as needed: mustard).
Lavare bene la pancetta di maiale sotto: Wash the pork belly well under cold water and dry it.
Rinse the sauerkraut and squeeze it.
In una pentola larga stendere metà dei c: In a wide pot spread half the sauerkraut, lay the pork belly on it and cover it with the rest.
Versare l'acqua, coprire e cuocere a fuo: Pour in the water, cover and cook over a low heat for about 2 hours, adding a little water if it dries out, until the pork belly is tender.
Per la polenta portare a bollore l'acqua: For the polenta, bring the polenta water to the boil with the salt and pour in the maize flour in a stream, stirring with the whisk.
Cuocere la polenta 45 minuti a fuoco bas: Cook the polenta for 45 minutes over a low heat, stirring often with a wooden spoon, until it comes away from the sides.
Tagliare la pancetta a fette e servirla: Slice the pork belly and serve it on the sauerkraut with the hot polenta; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days and reheats well.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 7.87: the pork belly, well washed, cooks for about two hours in the middle of the sour cabbage (sauerkraut) and «si gusta colla polenta» (is enjoyed with polenta).
Sciogliere il lievito di birra in poca a: Dissolve the brewer's yeast in a little lukewarm water, then add it to the rest of the water.
Sciogliere il sale in un cucchiaio d'acq: Dissolve the salt in a spoonful of water.
Versare la farina sulla spianatoia, unir: Pour the flour onto the pastry board, add the dissolved yeast and the salt and knead hard for 10 minutes, with open hands and closed fists.
Mettere la pasta in una ciotola fonda, c: Put the dough in a deep bowl, cover it with a floured tea towel and leave it to rise overnight (10-12 hours) in a sheltered place, until tripled.
Rovesciarla sulla spianatoia e lavorarla: Turn it out onto the board and work it again for 20 minutes without adding flour, slapping it down, into a smooth, elastic ball.
Dividerla in 2 pezzi e formare due pani: Divide it into 2 pieces and shape two cylindrical loaves 35-40 cm long.
Metterli sulla teglia unta di burro e in: Put them on the baking tray greased with butter and floured, cover them and leave them to rise somewhere warm for 1 hour, until doubled.
Scaldare il forno a 230 °C, bagnare i pa: Heat the oven to 230 °C, moisten the loaves with cold water and bake them for 35-40 minutes, until golden and they sound hollow when tapped underneath.
Cuocere 40-50 minuti, finché battendo so: Bake for 40-50 minutes, until they sound hollow when tapped underneath, and moisten them again as soon as they come out of the oven so that the crust shines.
Lasciarli raffreddare su una griglia; av: Leave them to cool on a rack; wrapped in a tea towel they keep for 3 days.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 0.1, the first in the book: for every kilo of flour 10 g of «di Vienna» (Viennese) brewer's yeast, half a litre of water and 20-25 g of salt; it makes two loaves «della lunghezza di due palmi scarsi» (barely two hand-spans long).
Al mattino sciogliere il lievito di birr: In the morning dissolve the brewer's yeast in 150 ml of lukewarm water, add 285 g of flour and work in a bowl into a medium-firm dough.
Coprire e lasciar lievitare in luogo tie: Cover and leave to rise somewhere lukewarm for 2 hours, until tripled.
Sulla spianatoia unire al lievitino i 75: On the pastry board add the 750 g of flour, the salt and the rest of the water a little at a time to the starter, and knead for 15 minutes into a firm, smooth dough.
Rimettere in una ciotola infarinata, cop: Put it back in a floured bowl, cover and leave to rise for 1 1/2 hours near a source of heat, until doubled.
Reimpastare brevemente senza aggiungere: Knead again briefly without adding anything and divide into 4 pieces.
Allungare ognuno in un cordone di circa: Stretch each one into a rope about 40 cm long and twist it on itself, joining the ends.
Mettere i pani sulla teglia unta di burr: Put the loaves on the baking tray greased with butter and floured, cover them and leave them to rise somewhere warm for 45 minutes, until doubled.
Cuocere in forno già caldo a 220 °C per: Bake in an oven already hot at 220 °C for 30-35 minutes, until golden.
Appena sfornati bagnarli con acqua fresc: As soon as they come out of the oven moisten them with cold water and leave them to cool on a rack; they keep for 2-3 days in a paper bag.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 0.2: the starter is made early in the morning with 30 g of yeast and 285 g of flour; with the same dough you can make «piccie», rows of 4-6 loaves joined lengthways.
La sera sciogliere il lievito di birra i: In the evening dissolve the brewer's yeast in 250 ml of lukewarm water.
Scaldare appena la farina di segale in u: Warm the rye flour slightly in a bowl, make a hollow in the centre, pour in the yeast and stir in with the spoon as much flour as it takes for a thick but soft dough.
Coprire e lasciar lievitare tutta la not: Cover and leave to rise all night (10-12 hours), until tripled.
Al mattino pulire i semi di anice strofi: In the morning clean the aniseed by rubbing it in a tea towel.
Unire il resto della farina, il sale, l': Add the rest of the flour, the salt, the aniseed and another 400 ml of lukewarm water and work with closed fists for 15 minutes, until the dough is smooth and comes away from your hands.
Lasciar lievitare coperto 2 ore, finché: Leave to rise covered for 2 hours, until doubled.
Rilavorare con forza sulla spianatoia e: Work it hard again on the board and shape two loaves, long or round.
Metterli sulla teglia infarinata e lasci: Put them on the floured baking tray and leave them to rise a third time, covered, for 1 hour.
Scaldare il forno a 230 °C, bagnare i pa: Heat the oven to 230 °C, moisten the loaves with lukewarm water and bake them for 50-60 minutes, until they sound hollow when tapped underneath.
Lasciarli raffreddare su una griglia; av: Leave them to cool on a rack; wrapped in a tea towel it keeps for a week.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 0.3: rye bread with the baker's leaven and a scant handful of «anici di Puglia» (Apulian aniseed); it can be made with brewer's yeast, 12 g per kilo of flour, or with half rye and half wheat.
Sciogliere il lievito di birra in 250 ml: Dissolve the brewer's yeast in 250 ml of lukewarm water.
Unire 125 g di farina 0 e 125 g di farin: Add 125 g of type 0 flour and 125 g of maize flour, mix into a thick batter and salt lightly.
Coprire e lasciar lievitare in luogo tie: Cover and leave to rise somewhere lukewarm for 1 hour, until doubled.
Sulla spianatoia disporre le farine rima: On the pastry board put the remaining flours, mixed, and pour in the risen batter, the rest of the water and the salt.
Impastare 15 minuti fino a un pastone so: Knead for 15 minutes into a firm, smooth dough.
Dividere in 2 pezzi e formare due pani c: Divide into 2 pieces and shape two cylindrical loaves.
Metterli sulla teglia unta di burro e in: Put them on the baking tray greased with butter and floured, cover them and leave them to rise somewhere lukewarm for 1 hour, until doubled.
Cuocere in forno già caldo a 210 °C per: Bake in an oven already hot at 210 °C for 40-45 minutes.
Un momento prima di sfornarli spennellar: Just before taking them out, brush them with the beaten egg white and put them back in the oven for 2 minutes, until they shine.
Lasciarli raffreddare su una griglia; si: Leave them to cool on a rack; they keep for 2-3 days in a paper bag.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, “Il piccolo focolare” (Trento, 1921), recipe 0.5: a leavened batter of white and yellow flour, then more white and yellow flour “in parti eguali” (in equal parts); the loaves are brushed with cold water or egg white just before they come out of the oven.
Sciogliere il lievito di birra nei 100 m: Dissolve the brewer's yeast in the 100 ml of lukewarm milk and add 250 g of flour.
Coprire e lasciar lievitare vicino a una: Cover and leave to rise near a source of heat for 1 hour, until more than doubled.
Sulla spianatoia unire 750 g di farina a: On the pastry board combine 750 g of flour, just warmed, the salt, the sugar and the cleaned aniseed.
Versare il lievitino e il latte poco all: Pour in the starter and the milk a little at a time and knead for a long time, 15 minutes, beating the dough with the rolling pin until smooth and elastic.
Metterlo sulla teglia unta di burro e in: Put it on the baking tray greased with butter and floured (or in a basket lined with a floured tea towel), cover and leave to rise somewhere warm for 1 1/2 hours, until doubled.
Scaldare il forno a 200 °C e spennellare: Heat the oven to 200 °C and brush the loaf with the hot milk.
Cuocere 45-50 minuti, finché è dorato e: Bake for 45-50 minutes, until golden and it sounds hollow when tapped underneath.
Lasciarlo raffreddare su una griglia; si: Leave it to cool on a rack; it keeps for 3 days wrapped in a tea towel.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 0.6: bread of raw milk with two or three spoonfuls of sugar and a spoonful of Apulian aniseed, brushed before baking «con una penna intinta nel latte caldo» (with a feather dipped in hot milk).
La sera sciogliere il lievito di birra i: In the evening dissolve the brewer's yeast in a little lukewarm water with 6 spoonfuls of flour and leave it near the stove for 1 hour, until more than doubled.
Sciogliere il burro nel resto dell'acqua: Melt the butter in the rest of the lukewarm water.
In una ciotola unire il lievitino, il ch: In a bowl combine the starter, the kilo of flour, the water with the butter and the salt.
Lavorare con le mani 10 minuti, finché l: Work with your hands for 10 minutes, until the dough comes away from your fingers.
Coprire bene e lasciar riposare tutta la: Cover well and leave to rest all night (10-12 hours) in a sheltered place.
Al mattino rovesciare la pasta sulla spi: In the morning turn the dough out onto the board and work it hard for 10 minutes without adding anything.
Dividerla in 8 pani uguali e metterli su: Divide it into 8 equal rolls and put them on the baking tray greased with butter and floured.
Coprire e lasciar lievitare al caldo 1 o: Cover and leave to rise somewhere warm for 1 hour, until puffed and light.
Cuocere in forno già caldo a 220 °C per: Bake in an oven already hot at 220 °C for 25-30 minutes, brushing them with the milk halfway through.
Lasciarli raffreddare su una griglia; si: Leave them to cool on a rack; they keep for 2 days in a paper bag.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 0.7: starter in the evening, then a kilo of flour and a «quartuccio» (old measure) of lukewarm water with 40 g of butter; the rolls are brushed with milk halfway through baking.
Sciogliere il lievito di birra in poca a: Dissolve the brewer's yeast in a little lukewarm water, add it to the rest of the water, and dissolve the salt in a spoonful of water.
Sulla spianatoia impastare con forza la: On the pastry board knead the flour hard with the yeasted water and the salt for 10 minutes.
Mettere la pasta in una ciotola, coprirl: Put the dough in a bowl, cover it and leave it to rise overnight (10-12 hours), until tripled.
Ammollare l'uva sultanina 10 minuti in a: Soak the sultanas for 10 minutes in lukewarm water and squeeze them; slice the dried figs thinly and break up the walnut kernels.
Al mattino rilavorare la pasta 15 minuti: In the morning work the dough again for 15 minutes, working in the walnuts, sultanas and figs a little at a time.
Formare 2 pani lunghi e metterli sulla t: Shape 2 long loaves and put them on the baking tray greased with butter and floured.
Coprirli e lasciarli lievitare al caldo: Cover them and leave them to rise somewhere warm for 1 1/2 hours, until doubled.
Cuocere in forno già caldo a 220 °C per: Bake in an oven already hot at 220 °C for 50 minutes, moistening them with water before and after baking.
Lasciarli raffreddare su una griglia; av: Leave them to cool on a rack; wrapped in a tea towel they keep for a week.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 10.80: ordinary bread dough enriched with 250 g each of walnuts, sultanas and figs; «non si potrebbe chiamare un dolce, perché non c'entra zucchero» (it could not be called a cake, because there is no sugar in it), but it is just right for Alpine excursions and «i ragazzi ne sono ghiotti» (children love it).
Portare a bollore 4 litri d'acqua, salar: Bring 4 litres of water to the boil, salt it and cook the macaroni for the time given on the packet, 10-12 minutes.
Intanto sciogliere il burro in un pentol: Meanwhile melt the butter in a small pan and heat it for 2-3 minutes, until it foams and is boiling hot without darkening.
Scolare bene la pasta e versarla in una: Drain the pasta well and tip it into a hot bowl.
Versarvi sopra il burro bollente e mesco: Pour the boiling butter over it and stir.
Spolverare col parmigiano e mescolare an: Sprinkle with the parmesan and stir for another 30 seconds.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 3.3: for a kilo of pasta 50-60 g of boiling butter and 2-4 spoonfuls of parmesan «o altro cacio buono da minestra» (or another cheese good for pasta); for economy the butter can be replaced with fine lard.
Sbucciare le cipolle e tagliarle a fetti: Peel the onions and slice them thinly.
In una padella scaldare l'olio a fuoco m: In a frying pan heat the oil over a medium-low heat and cook the onions for 10-12 minutes, stirring, until red-brown but not burnt.
Intanto cuocere gli spaghetti in 4 litri: Meanwhile cook the spaghetti in 4 litres of salted water for the time given, 9-11 minutes.
Scolarli bene, tenendo un goccio d'acqua: Drain them well, keeping a drop of the cooking water.
Versare sulla pasta bollente l'olio con: Pour the oil with the onions over the hot pasta and stir, salting if needed.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 3.4: a few spoonfuls of oil in which sliced small onions are browned to red; a dressing that «s'addice particolarmente agli spaghetti per i giorni di magro» (particularly suits spaghetti for meatless days).
In una casseruola fonda mettere le cipol: In a deep casserole put the onions with the butter in knobs and lay the salted leg of veal on top.
Rosolare a fuoco medio 10-15 minuti, gir: Brown over a medium heat for 10-15 minutes, turning the meat, until it has taken on a good colour.
Bagnare con l'acqua a cucchiaiate e cuoc: Moisten with the water a spoonful at a time and cook over a low heat for 40 minutes, until a little sauce forms.
Unire la passata di pomodoro e cuocere a: Add the tomato passata and cook for another 10 minutes.
Togliere la carne, sgrassare il sugo col: Take out the meat, skim the fat off the sauce with a teaspoon and pass it through the sieve.
Cuocere i maccheroni in abbondante acqua: Cook the macaroni in plenty of salted water for the time given, 10-12 minutes, and drain them into a bowl.
Versarvi il sugo, mescolare bene e aggiu: Pour the sauce over them, mix well and add the parmesan.
Servire subito e portare poi la carne in: Serve at once and then bring the meat to the table with a vegetable; the sauce keeps in the fridge for 2 days.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 3.8: 150 g of leg of veal or beef browned on 2-3 onions pounded in butter, then a little tomato sauce; the sieved sauce dresses a kilo of pasta and the meat is served with a vegetable, or else minced and added to the sauce.
Tagliare il lardo affumicato a dadini mi: Cut the smoked lard into tiny dice.
Metterli in un tegamino a fuoco medio-ba: Put them in a small pan over a medium-low heat and fry them for 5-6 minutes, until the fat becomes transparent.
Unire il burro e scaldarlo 1 minuto, fin: Add the butter and heat it for 1 minute, until melted and smoking.
Intanto cuocere i maccheroni in abbondan: Meanwhile cook the macaroni in plenty of salted water for the time given, 10-12 minutes.
Scolarli bene e versarvi sopra il condim: Drain them well and pour the boiling dressing over them, stirring.
Servire subito col parmigiano a parte; n: Serve at once with parmesan on the side; it does not keep.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 3.9: «lardo rosso» (red lard), that is smoked lard with fat and lean, 50-60 g in tiny dice for a kilo of pasta, with a piece of butter the size of a walnut; cheese on the side.
Pulire le acciughe dal sale e dalla lisc: Clean the salt and bones from the anchovies.
Tritarle a coltello insieme al tonno sgo: Chop them with a knife together with the drained tuna.
In una padella scaldare l'olio a fuoco m: In a frying pan heat the oil over a medium heat and fry the onions for 6-8 minutes, until they colour.
Unire il trito di tonno e acciughe e mes: Add the chopped tuna and anchovies and stir for 2-3 minutes, until the anchovies dissolve.
Intanto cuocere gli spaghetti in abbonda: Meanwhile cook the spaghetti in plenty of lightly salted water for the time given, 9-11 minutes.

In un padellino sciogliere lo strutto e: In a small pan melt the lard and brown the sugar for 3 minutes, until hazelnut-coloured.
Versarlo sulle rape e mescolare con deli: Pour it over the turnips and stir gently so as not to break them.
Cuocere ancora 20 minuti a fuoco basso,: Cook for another 20 minutes over a low heat, until the turnips have taken on a fine golden-red colour.
Servire calde come contorno di carni di: Serve hot as a side dish for pork; they keep in the fridge for 2 days.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 8.38: «la maniera migliore di preparare le rape» (the best way of preparing turnips): in sticks, cooked for an hour in a little water, then browned with two spoonfuls of sugar caramelised in lard for every kilo and a half, until they take on a fine red colour. It is a dish of the whole province of Trento: here it is listed under the provincial capital.
Pasta: disporre la farina a fontana, rom: Dough: heap the flour in a well, break the eggs into the centre and knead for 10 minutes, until you have a smooth, elastic dough; rest for 30 minutes, covered.
Ripieno: mescolare la ricotta fresca con: Filling: mix the fresh ricotta with the egg, parsley, nutmeg, grana and a pinch of salt.
Tirare una sfoglia sottile, circa 1 mm,: Roll out a thin sheet, about 1 mm, and without letting it dry cut out discs with a 7 cm glass.
Rimpastare i ritagli e ripetere fino a f: Knead the trimmings together again and repeat until the dough is used up.
Mettere al centro di ogni disco una pall: Put a little ball of filling in the centre of each disc and fold it into a half-moon, pressing the edges well so that they do not open during cooking.
Scaldare la salsa di pomodoro in un pent: Heat the tomato sauce in a small pan over a low heat for 5 minutes.
Cuocere i ravioli in acqua salata a boll: Cook the ravioli in boiling salted water for 4-5 minutes, until they float.
Sciogliere il burro, scolare i ravioli e: Melt the butter, drain the ravioli and dress them with the butter, the grana for serving and the hot tomato sauce.
Servire subito; crudi si conservano in f: Serve at once; uncooked, they keep in the fridge for 1 day on a floured tray.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 3.13: discs of tagliatelle dough folded into half-moons and dressed with butter, cheese and tomato sauce. The book gives three fillings: ricotta (this one), spinach with cinnamon or nutmeg, and leftover cooked meat browned with onion.
Pasta: impastare sulla spianatoia la far: Pastry: on the pastry board knead the flour with the soft butter in pieces, the sugar, the grated lemon zest and the baking powder, adding the milk a little at a time until you have a soft dough; work it as little as possible.
Ripieno: tritare finissime le noci, le m: Filling: chop the walnuts, almonds and hazelnuts very finely, pound the cloves and add the breadcrumbs and cinnamon.
Scaldare il miele 1 minuto in un pentoli: Warm the honey for 1 minute in a small pan and pour it over the chopped nuts, stirring until you have a mixture that holds together.
Accendere il forno statico a 180 °C; ung: Turn the conventional oven on to 180 °C; grease a baking tray with the butter and dust it with the flour for the tray.
Tirare la pasta a 4 mm di spessore e tag: Roll the pastry out 4 mm thick and cut it into 9 cm squares.
Mettere un cucchiaio di ripieno su ogni: Put a spoonful of filling on each square and fold it into a triangle, pressing the edges well.
Spennellare i fiadoni con l'uovo sbattut: Brush the fiadoni with the beaten egg and sprinkle them with pearl sugar.
Disporli nella teglia e cuocerli 20 minu: Arrange them on the tray and bake them for 20 minutes, until golden.
Lasciarli raffreddare su una gratella e: Leave them to cool on a rack and serve; they keep for 1 week in a tin.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, “Il piccolo focolare” (Trento, 1921), recipe 10.81: “Ravioli o fiadoni”, triangles of sweet lemon pastry filled with almonds, hazelnuts or walnuts pounded with breadcrumbs and bound with warm honey, cinnamon and cloves; the book closes with the proverb “Chi più mangia meno mangia” (the more you eat, the less you eat).
Pulire le acciughe salate sotto l'acqua,: Clean the salted anchovies under the water, remove the backbone and chop the flesh.
In una casseruola scaldare bene l'olio,: In a casserole heat the oil well, add the butter and let it melt over a medium heat.
Soffriggere la cipolla con le acciughe 5: Fry the onion with the anchovies for 5 minutes, crushing them until they dissolve.
Buttare il riso e tostarlo 2 minuti, mes: Tip in the rice and toast it for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Bagnare con l'acqua bollente poco per vo: Moisten with the boiling water a little at a time and cook for 16-18 minutes, stirring often.
Assaggiare, regolare di sale e mantecare: Taste, adjust the salt and stir in the parmesan.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 3.24: meatless rice browned in oil and butter with onion and sardine flesh, finished with water and the «solito parmigiano» (usual parmesan); «col brodo di carne, di pesce o di ranocchi diventa ancor migliore» (with meat, fish or frog broth it becomes even better).
Raccogliere gli avanzi misti cotti e tag: Gather the mixed cooked leftovers and cut the polenta and the larger vegetables into 2 cm pieces.
In una padella larga scaldare lo strutto: In a wide frying pan heat the lard over a fierce heat until very hot.
Mettere tutti gli avanzi in uno strato e: Put all the leftovers in a layer and let them brown for 5 minutes without touching them, until a crust forms.
Girarli e rosolarli altri 5-6 minuti, sa: Turn them and brown them for another 5-6 minutes, salting if needed.
Servire subito con la salsa di pomodoro: Serve at once with hot tomato sauce; it does not keep.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 3.37: «rostisciana» is «un piatto eccellente fatto di avanzi d'ogni genere» (an excellent dish made of leftovers of every kind), pasta, rice, gnocchi, polenta, vegetables and meat, roasted together in boiling lard; good with meat juices or tomato sauce. It is not the Tuscan rosticciana of spare ribs.
Lavare le salsicce fresche di maiale e a: Wash the fresh pork sausages and dry them.
Metterle in un tegame basso senza altri: Put them in a shallow pan without any other fat, over a medium heat.
Sbucciare le mele, togliere il torsolo e: Peel the apples, remove the cores and cut them into 1 cm slices.
Dopo 10 minuti, quando le salsicce sono: After 10 minutes, when the sausages have coloured, add the apples and a little water.
Cuocere a fuoco basso 25 minuti, bagnand: Cook over a low heat for 25 minutes, moistening from time to time with the remaining water, until the sausages are cooked and the apples soft.
Servire calde con il loro sughetto; si c: Serve hot with their juices; they keep in the fridge for 2 days.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 7.88: the sausages are floured and cooked for half an hour in a shallow pan with no other fat, moistened with a little water or broth; «in certe regioni» (in some areas) white grapes are added, in others slices of apple. They are enjoyed with polenta.
Pulire le sardelle fresche: togliere tes: Clean the fresh sardines: remove the heads and innards, wash them and dry them.
Tritare l'aglio e grattugiare la scorza: Chop the garlic and grate the lemon zest.
In un tegame basso scaldare l'olio e sof: In a shallow pan heat the oil and fry the breadcrumbs with the garlic, zest, salt and pepper for 2 minutes, until golden.
Arrange the sardines on top in a single layer.
Versare l'acqua fredda e cuocere a fuoco: Pour in the cold water and cook over a brisk heat for 15-20 minutes, shaking the pan.
Tostare le fette di pane casereccio sull: Toast the slices of country bread on the grill for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crisp, and wipe them round the pan to soak up the juices.
Servire subito le sardelle con il pane;: Serve the sardines at once with the bread; they keep in the fridge for 1 day.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 9.13: fresh sardines are cooked «in fretta una ventina di minuti» (quickly, for about twenty minutes) in a pan in which breadcrumbs have been fried in oil with pepper, salt, lemon zest and garlic, and the juices are mopped up with slices of bread; «in questo modo si allestiscono molti pesci piccoli» (many small fish are prepared this way).
Tagliare la fesa di vitello a fettine di: Cut the veal topside into 5 mm slices and beat them lightly.
Affettare finissime le cipolle e stender: Slice the onions very thinly and spread them over the bottom of a shallow casserole.
Appoggiare le fettine sulle cipolle e sp: Lay the slices on the onions and dot the butter in knobs over the top.
Rosolare a fuoco vivo 5-6 minuti, finché: Brown over a fierce heat for 5-6 minutes, until the meat has coloured.
Abbassare al minimo, coprire e cuocere 4: Lower the heat to the minimum, cover and cook for 45 minutes, moistening from time to time with a small ladle of ready-made meat broth.
Salare, aggiungere la passata di pomodor: Salt, add the tomato passata and cook slowly for another 15 minutes, until the sauce is thick.
Servire calde con la polenta; si conserv: Serve hot with polenta; they keep in the fridge for 2 days.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 7.39: the scaloppine are cooked covered over the embers for three quarters of an hour and served «colla polenta» (with polenta); without tomato, she writes, they become plain scaloppine.
Tagliare la fesa di vitello a fettine di: Cut the veal topside into 5 mm slices and beat them with the back of the knife.
Stenderle in una padella bassa con il bu: Spread them in a shallow pan with the butter in small pieces among them.
Cuocerle a fuoco medio-basso 5 minuti, f: Cook them over a medium-low heat for 5 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink and the flour has almost disappeared.
Spargere sopra il prezzemolo tritato e c: Scatter the chopped parsley over the top and cover with the whole milk.
Sobbollire a fuoco lento 30-40 minuti, s: Simmer over a slow heat for 30-40 minutes, lifting and turning the slices often with the spatula.
Salare solo alla fine: le scaloppine dev: Salt only at the end: the scaloppine must stay almost white, with a creamy sauce.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 7.40: the slices, covered with «latte buono» (good milk), simmer for 30-40 minutes and the salt goes in last; «queste scaloppine devono restare quasi bianche» (these scaloppine must stay almost white).
Lavare bene la scorzonera e raschiarla c: Wash the black salsify well and scrape it with a small knife until the dark skin is removed.
Portare a bollore l'acqua con un pugno d: Bring the water to the boil with a fistful of salt.
Stemperare la farina in un mestolino d'a: Blend the flour in a small ladle of cold water and pour it into the pot: it keeps the roots white.
Cuocere la scorzonera 20-25 minuti, finc: Cook the salsify for 20-25 minutes, until the tip of a knife goes in without effort.
Scolarla e condirla ancora calda con l'o: Drain it and dress it while still hot with the extra virgin olive oil, salt and pepper.
Servire tiepida; si conserva in frigo 2: Serve warm; it keeps in the fridge for 2 days.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 8.41: black and white salsify, washed and scraped, are cooked in salted water «con una manatella di farina» (with a small handful of flour) and dressed with oil, pepper and salt, or else fried.
Cuocere le uova 9 minuti dal bollore, ra: Cook the eggs for 9 minutes from boiling, cool them in cold water and shell them.
Tagliarle a metà per il lungo e togliere: Cut them in half lengthways and remove the yolks.
Pestare o frullare metà dei tuorli col b: Pound or blend half the yolks with the soft butter and the drained tuna in oil until you have a cream.
Unire a goccia a goccia il succo di mezz: Add the juice of half a lemon drop by drop, a pinch of salt and pepper.
Riempire gli albumi con la crema, dandol: Fill the whites with the cream, shaping it into a little ball.
Per la salsa: schiacciare i tuorli rimas: For the sauce: crush the remaining yolks with the mustard and whisk them with the extra virgin olive oil poured in a thin stream, until thick; salt.
Disporre le uova sul piatto con la salsa: Arrange the eggs on the plate with the sauce around them and serve cold; they keep 1 day in the fridge, covered.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 5.10: a «piatto di lusso» (luxury dish) with yolks, fresh butter and tuna in oil pounded in the mortar; the chapter closes with the proverb «Pasqua tanto desiata in un giorno è passata» (Easter, so longed for, is over in a day).
Wash and dry the shoulder of lamb.
Salt it and coat it in the flour.
In una casseruola sciogliere il burro a: In a casserole melt the butter over a medium heat and brown the shoulder for 10 minutes, until golden on all sides.
Abbassare il fuoco e bagnarla con 2-3 cu: Lower the heat and moisten it with 2-3 spoonfuls of milk.
Cuocere coperto 1 ora e mezza, aggiungen: Cook covered for 1 1/2 hours, adding more milk each time it has been absorbed.
È pronta quando la carne si stacca dall': It is ready when the meat comes away from the bone, after 1½ to 2 hours.
Servirla a pezzi col suo fondo; si conse: Serve it in pieces with its juices; it keeps in the fridge for 2 days.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 7.60: the floured shoulder is moistened with «2-3 cucchiai di latte» (2-3 spoonfuls of milk), adding more when it has been absorbed; cooking «ore 1 1/2 — 2» (1 1/2 to 2 hours).
Fiammeggiare i pezzi di tacchino per tog: Singe the pieces of turkey to remove the last feathers and wash them.
Chop the lard to a cream.
In una pentola portare a bollore l'acqua: In a pot bring the water to the boil with the salt, carrot, celery, onion, leek, parsley and the lard battuto.
Immergere il tacchino solo quando l'acqu: Put in the turkey only when the water is boiling.
Cuocere a fuoco basso, appena sobbollent: Cook over a low heat, barely simmering, for 2 hours (3 if the bird is old), skimming during the first 15 minutes.
Servirlo a fette con un po' del suo brod: Serve it sliced with a little of its broth; the strained broth is used for soups and keeps in the fridge for 3 days.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 7.117: turkey is boiled, best the breast and wings, with the usual herbs of no. 7.109 and, if old, with a little battuto of lard and several hours of boiling.
Incidere le castagne e cuocerle in forno: Score the chestnuts and cook them in the oven at 200 °C for 30 minutes, then peel them while still hot.
Bagnare la mollica nel latte e strizzarl: Soak the soft breadcrumb in the milk and squeeze it out.
Pestare le castagne con la mollica, i fe: Pound the chestnuts with the breadcrumb, the chopped chicken livers, the crumbled sausage, the chopped parsley, nutmeg, salt and pepper, and bind with the egg.
Strofinare l'interno della tacchinella c: Rub the inside of the young turkey with salt, fill it with the stuffing and sew up the opening with string.
Abbassare il forno a 180 °C e metterla i: Lower the oven to 180 °C and put it in a roasting tin with the butter in knobs and the pounded lard around it.
Cuocerla 2 ore e mezza, girandola spesso: Cook it for 2½ hours, turning it often and basting it with its own fat.
Salarla fuori quando comincia a fare la: Salt it on the outside when it starts to foam.
È pronta quando è dorata e, bucando la c: It is ready when golden and clear juices run when the thigh is pierced; serve it hot, sliced, with the stuffing; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 7.118: roast turkey is made like the chicken of no. 7.110, in the oven with butter and its own fat, also stuffed with chestnuts, cooking it for two to three hours.
Lessare la testina di vitello in acqua s: Boil the calf's head in salted water with the carrot and half an onion, over a low heat, for 2 hours.
Scolarla, lasciarla intiepidire 15 minut: Drain it, leave it to cool slightly for 15 minutes and cut it into 1 cm slices.
Tritare finissimi il resto della cipolla: Very finely chop the rest of the onion, the garlic and the parsley and mix them with the oil.
Passare le fettine nel battuto, poi nel: Dip the slices in the battuto, then in the breadcrumbs, pressing well.
Scaldare la griglia a fuoco vivo per 5 m: Heat the grill over a high heat for 5 minutes.
Cuocere le fettine 3-4 minuti per lato,: Cook the slices for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden and crisp.
Salarle appena tolte dal fuoco e servirl: Salt them as soon as they come off the heat and serve them at once, piping hot; they do not keep.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 7.17: calf's head cooked for a couple of hours, cut into thin slices, wrapped in a little battuto of onion, garlic and parsley and in breadcrumbs and cooked on the grill, «salandole quando sono fumanti» (salting them while they are piping hot).
Squamare la tinca, svuotarla, lavarla be: Scale the tench, gut it, wash it well, remove the backbone and cut it into 5 cm pieces; season them with salt and pepper.
Tritare fini le cipolle, la carota e il: Finely chop the onions, carrot and celery.
In una casseruola scaldare l'olio a fuoc: In a casserole heat the oil over a medium heat with the garlic clove and the chopped mixture; remove the garlic as soon as it turns golden.
Adagiare i pezzi di tinca e farli colori: Lay in the pieces of tench and let them colour for 5 minutes on each side.
Spolverare con la farina e lasciarla arr: Dust with the flour and let it brown for 2 minutes.
Bagnare con l'acqua un poco per volta e: Moisten with the water a little at a time and cook over a slow heat for 1 hour, covered.
Unire la passata di pomodoro e cuocere a: Add the tomato passata and cook slowly for another 5-10 minutes.
Servire con la polenta calda; in frigo s: Serve with hot polenta; it keeps in the fridge for a day.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 9.7: a one-kilo tench on a soffritto of onions and aromatics, coloured, dusted with flour, cooked for an hour with plain water and finished with tomato sauce, to be served «colla polenta» (with polenta). Quantities estimated for the ingredients the source gives as «q.b.» (as needed: hot polenta).
Squamare le tinche, svuotarle e lavarle: Scale the tench, gut them and wash them well; if large, halve them, bone them and cut them into pieces.
In un tegame largo scaldare l'olio a fuo: In a wide pan heat the oil over a medium heat with the garlic clove.
Adagiare i pesci con le erbe, sale e pep: Lay in the fish with the herbs, salt and pepper.
Dopo 3-4 minuti spolverarli con la farin: After 3-4 minutes dust them with the flour and let them brown for another 5 minutes, turning them; remove the garlic.
Bagnarli con il vino bianco secco un poc: Moisten them with the dry white wine a little at a time, waiting for them to absorb it.
Cuocere in tutto 20 minuti a fuoco medio: Cook for 20 minutes in all over a medium-low heat, until the juices have almost dried up.
Servire caldi; in frigo si conservano un: Serve hot; they keep in the fridge for a day.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 9.6: tench in a pan with oil, herbs, pepper, salt and garlic, dusted with flour and moistened little by little «con acqua pura o meglio con vino bianco» (with plain water or, better, white wine), served almost dry.
Accendere il forno statico a 200 °C, tag: Turn the conventional oven on to 200 °C, cut the barucca pumpkin into wedges, remove the seeds and fibres and bake it for 50 minutes, until tender.
Pesare 500 g di polpa senza scorza e sch: Weigh 500 g of flesh without the skin and mash it or pass it through the sieve, so that no lumps remain.
Abbassare il forno a 170 °C, imburrare u: Lower the oven to 170 °C, butter a cake tin and dust it with flour.
In una terrina lavorare il burro morbido: In a bowl work the soft butter until creamy.
Unire le uova una alla volta, alternando: Add the eggs one at a time, alternating them with the sugar a spoonful at a time, and work for a long time with a light hand, always in the same direction, until the mixture is foamy.
Aggiungere il pangrattato, la polpa di z: Add the breadcrumbs, the pumpkin flesh, the grated almonds and the finely chopped lemon zest, with a spoonful of its juice.
Versare nella tortiera e cuocere 45 minu: Pour into the tin and bake for 45 minutes, until a toothpick comes out dry.
Servirla fredda; si conserva 3 giorni in: Serve it cold; it keeps for 3 days in a cool place.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 10.50: barucca or «marina» pumpkin baked in the oven and worked with butter, eggs and sugar; «essa si fa ancor migliore se vi si aggiunge una manatina di mandorle grattate» (it becomes even better with a small handful of grated almonds added).
Incidere le castagne crude, lessarle in: Score the raw chestnuts, boil them in water for 20 minutes and peel them while still hot, removing the inner skin too.
Finire di cuocerle nel latte a fuoco bas: Finish cooking them in the milk over a low heat for 15 minutes, stirring often, until they fall apart.
Schiacciarle e passarle al setaccio: si: Mash them and pass them through the sieve: you get about 280 g of purée.
Accendere il forno statico a 160 °C, imb: Turn the conventional oven on to 160 °C; butter and flour a shallow cake tin.
Separare le uova e lavorare i tuorli con: Separate the eggs and work the yolks with the sugar for 10 minutes, until foamy and pale.
Unire la polpa di castagne e il rum, mes: Add the chestnut purée and the rum, stirring all the time.
Montare gli albumi a neve densa e incorp: Whisk the egg whites to firm peaks and fold them in with a light hand.
Prima di servire spolverizzarla col cioc: Before serving dust it with the grated dark chocolate; it keeps for 3 days under a cake dome.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 10.52: chestnuts boiled and finished in milk, passed through the sieve and worked with yolks, sugar, rum and whisked whites; the cake is dusted with chocolate before it is brought to the table.
Grattugiare la crosta dei panini rafferm: Grate off the crust of the stale bread rolls and keep it aside; cut the crumb into slices.
Cuocere la mollica nel latte con la scor: Cook the crumb in the milk with the finely chopped lemon zest over a low heat for 10 minutes, stirring, until it becomes a mush; leave it to cool slightly.
Lavare le ciliegie nere e togliere i gam: Wash the black cherries and remove the stalks.
Accendere il forno statico a 175 °C, imb: Turn the conventional oven on to 175 °C, butter a cake tin and sprinkle it with half the grated crust.
In una terrina lavorare il burro morbido: In a bowl work the soft butter, then add the yolks of the 4 eggs one at a time and the sugar.
Aggiungere la pappa di pane e mescolare: Add the bread mush and mix well.
Montare gli albumi a neve e incorporarli: Whisk the egg whites to peaks and fold them in with a light hand, then add the cherries.
Versare nella tortiera, spargere sopra l: Pour into the tin, scatter the remaining crust over the top and bake for 50 minutes, until golden and firm.
Servirla tiepida o fredda; si conserva i: Serve it warm or cold; it keeps in the fridge for 2 days.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (Trento, 1921), recipe 10.58: the crumb of five bread rolls cooked in milk with lemon, worked with butter, yolks and sugar and combined with whisked whites and «ciliege nere sugose» (juicy black cherries).
Setacciare la farina in una terrina e sa: Sift the flour into a bowl and salt it.
Versare il latte freddo poco alla volta,: Pour in the cold milk a little at a time, stirring carefully for 5 minutes, into a smooth, pourable but not too runny batter.
Ungere abbondantemente col burro una pad: Grease generously with the butter a wide, shallow iron frying pan (28 cm) that can go in the oven.
Versarvi la pastella in uno strato di ci: Pour in the batter in a layer about 2 cm deep.
Cuocere in forno 30-35 minuti, finché il: Bake for 30-35 minutes, until the tortino is golden top and bottom.
Servirlo caldo, a spicchi; si conserva 1: Serve it hot, in wedges; it keeps for 1 day and is reheated in a frying pan.
Giulia Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focola: Giulia Lazzari-Turco, “Il piccolo focolare” (Trento, 1921), recipe 4.14: a flour-and-milk pie baked in the oven or among the embers until it takes on “a fine golden colour above and below”; the book also gives the version with eggs and the “German-style” one, in small squares browned in lard, with slices of apple or pear.
Portare a bollore il latte e versarlo su: Bring the milk to the boil and pour it over the maize flour in a bowl, mixing well.
Lasciar riposare 30 minuti, perché la fa: Leave to rest for 30 minutes, so that the flour swells.
Unire al composto le uova intere e il sa: Add the whole eggs and the salt to the mixture and mix.
